card: This PR replaces instances of BOOST_FAIL with REQUIRE and attaches descriptor context across test assertions in descriptor unit tests. It helps clean up low-usage Boost Test macros to assist the broader effort to deprecate or replace the Boost unit test runner (#35713). It also improves failure diagnostics when descriptor tests fail by ensuring relevant descriptors are printed.
evidence: Found in #35713 as low usage macros (PR description)
problem: Efforts to migrate away from Boost Test (such as #35713) are complicated by lingering uses of specialized or low-usage Boost macros like `BOOST_FAIL`. Additionally, failure diagnostics in descriptor tests only intermittently included the active public or private descriptor string.

risk.why: A mistake would only affect unit test execution or assertion failure reporting.

scope_notes: The diff was not provided, but metadata indicates a small 26-line cleanup across two test files.
summary: Replaces usages of `BOOST_FAIL` with standard `REQUIRE` checks in unit tests and attaches descriptor strings as persistent context across test assertions in descriptor unit tests. This eliminates infrequently used Boost Test assertion macros in preparation for transitioning test runners.
